Paramedical Student Detained Over Bomb-Making Diagrams in Ayodhya

Security agencies in Ayodhya have detained a paramedical student from Balrampur after finding handwritten notes detailing bomb-making methods and chemical descriptions on his person. The student, who is reportedly from a medical college campus, was taken into custody by the ATS for questioning. His phone also contained reels related to explosions. The discovery has heightened security alertness in the area.
